dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: *sigh* You're not gonna make some story up to scare me off, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: "Oh, you can't touch this, or the Gardes will catch you!"

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Adults are so boring. That blonde guy I met at Leschots's is way cooler.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: He doesn't say much, but he lets me open his clockwork penguins up.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: That penguin was super cute, and its internals were really interesting as well. I think he made it himself, actually! Oh, I'm so envious of him!
